name: GNU Project
body: Two-year HSTS on https, nosniff, framing limited to its origin, and a sitemap. But http://www.gnu.org/ serves the page itself with a 200 instead of redirecting, so a first http visit stays unencrypted.
lesson: Redirect every http request to https with a 301. HSTS only helps after the browser has seen https once.
summary: www.gnu.org scores 74 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 20 are at risk, and 16 pass. Fix first: plain http serves the site without redirecting.

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 200. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: Links carry email addresses in the URL
fix.evidence: 1 link on /people/people.html put an email address in the query string. Analytics tools record full URLs, and Google's terms forbid sending personal data.
fix.fix: Move the email out of the URL (POST it, or use an opaque token).

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 15 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /gnu/gnu.html, /philosophy/philosophy.html, /licenses/licenses.html, /education/education.html and 11 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: 20 pages have no canonical link
fix.evidence: /, /gnu/gnu.html, /philosophy/philosophy.html, /licenses/licenses.html and 16 more. Without it, tracking parameters and trailing slashes can split ranking signals.
fix.fix: Add <link rel="canonical" href="…"> with the page's own https URL.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 608 ms
